subject: Joint close playbook — MAP draft & procurement cutoff confirmation
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Jansen <elaine.jansen@novocorp.com>, procure@novocorp.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 22 Jan 2027 14:04:00 -0500
Subject: Joint close playbook — MAP draft & procurement cutoff confirmation

Hi Elaine (and NovoCorp procurement team),

Thanks again for taking time this morning. Quick recap from our side + the draft MAP attached. Goal of this thread: lock in the target close date, identify any procurement gating items, and confirm who owns each milestone so we can sequence legal and procurement without surprises.

High level items I captured from the call: 
- Target commercial close: Feb 18, 2027 (tentative)
- Procurement/contract signature runway you requested: signed by Feb 11 to meet internal fiscal cutoff
- Key dependencies: SOC2 evidence review (security), customer IP addendum review (legal), finance approval for PO terms (procurement)

Attached: NovoCorp_MAP_Draft_v1.xlsx — I captured milestone owners and a proposed acceptance criteria column. Ben and Marissa are copied to align on technical handoffs and delivery milestones.

Proposed next steps (short):
1) Elaine/procurement: confirm signature cutoff of Feb 11 or propose alternate date
2) NovoCorp security/legal: flag any blockers on SOC2 evidence or contract addendum by Jan 27
3) Redwood (Ben): provide final integration timeline updates by Jan 25 so we can update MAP
4) Redwood (Grace): publish final MAP and send calendar invites for 1:1 procurement kickoff once signature runway confirmed

If the Feb 11 signature cutoff is tight, we can explore a staged acceptance plan (initial pilot + later additional entitlements) but want to understand what’s essential for your fiscal/process gating.

Thanks — cheers,
Grace

--
Grace O'Connor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0192
From: Elaine Jansen <elaine.jansen@novocorp.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: procure@novocorp.com, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 22 Jan 2027 15:02:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Joint close playbook — MAP draft & procurement cutoff confirmation

Grace — thanks for the clear recap and for sending the draft. Confirming a few items from our side: 

- Feb 11 signature cutoff is real for us; the finance calendar locks next-week budget approvals the week of Feb 14 and anything signed after Feb 11 will miss this run and push to the next fiscal window.
- Priority dependencies: SOC 2 report (we need the Type II summary and the CSV of control mappings), legal needs to see your standard IP addendum redline by Jan 28, and procurement needs a final PO template (we can accept an e-signed SOW + PO).
- Internal owners: I will own procurement coordination and finance sign-off; Paul Kim (cc'd on procure) will be the admin for the PO submission.

Two asks from NovoCorp: 
1) Can you provide the SOC2 artifact and a brief mapping doc to our control list by Jan 27?
2) If Ben can confirm the integration milestone that requires our security team’s sandbox access (and approximate dates), that will help us prioritize the control review.

I reviewed the attached MAP and added inline comments (see attached). If everything else holds, we are aiming to have legal and procurement sign-off in the week of Feb 7, with the formal signature by Feb 11.

Best,
Elaine

--
Elaine Jansen
Head of Procurement, NovoCorp
elaine.jansen@novocorp.com
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Elaine Jansen <elaine.jansen@novocorp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, procure@novocorp.com
Date: Fri, 22 Jan 2027 15:44:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Joint close playbook — MAP draft & procurement cutoff confirmation

Thanks, Elaine — appreciate the clarity on dates. Quick technical confirmations from our side: 

- SOC2 artifacts: we can provide the Type II summary PDF and the control mapping CSV by Jan 26 EOD. Grace, I'll drop both into the Drive link and flag to Elaine when uploaded.
- Sandbox access: we will need a sandbox endpoint and a short-lived key for initial integration. Targeting integration milestone in the MAP for Feb 1–4 (initial validation window). That should give your security team enough time to vet logs and traffic patterns before formal acceptance.

Note on signature timeline: Feb 11 is feasible but tight. If legal redlines arrive on Jan 28, our legal/ops can turn around within 3 business days in most cases, but we should avoid major SSO or data residency addenda late in the window. If anything material shows up, we'll escalate.

I agree Ben? (Oops — that was me) — Marissa, can you confirm the acceptance criteria row in tab 'Deliverables' aligns with the Feb 1–4 validation slot?

Thanks,
Ben

--
Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>

Date: Fri, 22 Jan 2027 16:18:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Joint close playbook — MAP draft & procurement cutoff confirmation

Great — thank you all for the quick turn. Per thread, here's the agreed-up MAP snapshot and immediate next actions (I updated the attached file accordingly):

Agreed MAP highlights: 
- Target commercial close: Feb 18, 2027 (commercial/ops readiness)
- Procurement signature cutoff: Feb 11, 2027 (firm for NovoCorp finance run)
- Integration validation window: Feb 1–4, 2027 (Redwood provides sandbox + short-lived key)
- Evidence delivery: SOC2 Type II summary + control mapping CSV by Jan 26
- Legal redline deadline for initial review: Jan 28 (to avoid slipping signature timeline)

Owners: 
- Procurement/Finance (NovoCorp): Elaine Jansen / Paul Kim (procure)
- Security/Controls (NovoCorp): NovoCorp security review team (contact via Elaine)
- Redwood integration & artifacts: Ben Carter (technical; sandbox & artifacts)
- Redwood PM & SOW: Marissa Cole (commercial milestones & acceptance criteria)
- Account lead / coordination: Grace O'Connor (calendar invites, MAP versioning)

Immediate next steps (owners & dates):
1) Ben: upload SOC2 summary + control mapping CSV to the Drive link by Jan 26 EOD — notify Elaine when complete.
2) Marissa: finalize acceptance criteria in MAP tab 'Deliverables' and confirm by Jan 25.
3) Elaine/Procurement: submit any legal addenda/redlines by Jan 28.
4) Grace: once signature runway confirmed (Feb 11), I'll send procurement kickoff invite and lock the MAP into HubSpot (link below).

Attachments: NovoCorp_MAP_Draft_v1.xlsx (updated), SOW-summary-onepager.pdf

If anything changes, reply in-thread with the blocker; otherwise I’ll circulate the finalized MAP on Monday with calendar invites for the validation window.

Thanks — looking forward to closing this smoothly.
Grace
